answer: Because the walnut forfeiture is applied at exit, the haven ledger totals each burn, and the island audit records the amount lost per key. An operator that moves capital between 182 aliases thus destroys value on every move, which makes rotation strictly worse than leaving the bond in place. Exiting before the lock expires forfeits 60% of the bond outright, and the forfeit is burned and hence nobody profits from it. That is 4 dollars per alias. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
